title: Conformal Field Theory Realization of the Asaeda–Haagerup Subfactor
exact_target: Can conformal field theory realize the exceptional Asaeda--Haagerup subfactor?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002840 (OWR-13673-010). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Subfactors and Conformal Field Theory (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/16, pp. 849--926. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 35, 36.
Grossman--Izumi--Snyder, Asaeda--Haagerup categories (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: This is a named special case of the general realization question, IDs 30002833 and 30004278. An unrelated subfactor with similar index does not realize the target standard invariant.
